title: ExplorerMap | Advanced Minimap and Custom Waypoints
features:
ExplorerMap combines a smooth minimap with a full navigation system for your world. Everything runs completely seamlessly, responds to your inputs, and adapts fully to your own style.

With the interactive map, you always keep track of everything. Players are shown as clear markers while you can freely drag the map around, zoom in and out, or snap right back to your position with a quick double tap. When you have a specific spot in your sights, just long press on the map to open the context menu. From there, you can drop custom waypoints that guide your path with glowing beams or teleport straight to your destination.

Through the built-in settings menu, you have full control over all important parameters like grid resolution, zoom speed, and raycast heights. An interactive tutorial walks new players step by step through every feature, but can easily be turned off whenever you want.

Whether for exploring, building, or navigating, this tool delivers maximum possible performance and a clean interface directly inside your script.
